steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each risk is placed by its rating and its review date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Review date passed
findings.fix: Review the risk and set the next date

findings.title: Matter in the quarter with no risk entry
findings.fix: Add a risk entry for the matter

outcome.notChecked: The legal assessment of each risk.

pros: Checks a risk with no rating, a review date passed, and a matter in the quarter with no risk entry.
cons: Not checked: The legal assessment of each risk.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-legal-risk-review skill on the records for this review.
